title: On Threatening the clerk with dismissal
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：threaten　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 threaten 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the director ① threatened the clerk with dismissal on the same day, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② threatens the clerk with dismissal before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ threaten the clerk with dismissal at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ threatened the clerk with dismissal before — a line in the poster for August 1971 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Threatening the clerk with dismissal on the same day, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ threaten the whole harvest with frost before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Threaten the whole harvest with frost at once and never mention it again.

By 1984 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ threatens the whole harvest with frost on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ threatened the clerk with dismissal again when nobody else would.

⑩ To threaten the clerk with dismissal, my mother said in 1989, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody threatens the clerk with dismissal before dawn again and somebody must threaten the clerk with dismissal on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 威胁（一般过去式 threatened the clerk with dismissal：1977 年导演头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 威胁（一般现在 threatens the clerk with dismissal：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 威胁（不定式 to threaten the clerk with dismissal：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 威胁（过去完成时 had threatened the clerk with dismissal：1971 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 威胁（动名词 threatening the clerk with dismissal 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 预示（threaten the whole harvest with frost：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去预示霜寒眼看要毁掉整季收成）
G. v. 预示（threaten the whole harvest with frost：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 威胁（后段两处：新来的演员照例 threatens the whole harvest with frost，而母亲又一次 threatened the clerk with dismissal）

items.q: to threaten the clerk with dismissal
threatened the clerk with dismissal before
threaten the whole harvest with frost before dawn
threaten the whole harvest with frost at once

answers.why: threaten 意为“威胁”，1977 年导演当天就威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 threatened。
threaten 意为“威胁”，自那以后导演天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 threatens。
threaten 意为“威胁”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员”，此处为不定式 to threaten the clerk with dismissal。
threaten 意为“威胁”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1984 年之前就有人威胁过，故用过去完成时 had threatened。
threaten 意为“威胁”，导演说“威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 threatening the clerk with dismissal 作主语。
threaten 意为“预示”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去预示霜寒眼看要毁掉整季收成”，should ever 之后用原形 threaten the whole harvest with frost。
threaten 意为“预示”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻预示霜寒眼看要毁掉整季收成（threaten the whole harvest with frost at once），以后再也不要提起。
threaten 意为“威胁”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例预示霜寒眼看要毁掉整季收成，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 threatens。
threaten 意为“威胁”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员，用一般过去式 threatened 叙述。
threaten 意为“威胁”，结尾那句是母亲 1989 年的话：要威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，导演当天就威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员；戏院里每一个演员都说这是头一回。（threatened the clerk with dismissal）
多年以后，导演仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（threatens the clerk with dismissal）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员这件事本身。（to threaten the clerk with dismissal）
早在 1971 年就有人威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员，八月那天戏报上的一行字就是证据。（had threatened the clerk with dismissal）
导演说过，当天就威胁以解雇威胁那位办事员这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（threatening the clerk with dismissal 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻预示霜寒眼看要毁掉整季收成，以后再也不要提起。（threaten the whole harvest with frost，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 threaten 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the director threatened the clerk with dismissal on the same day, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director threatens the clerk with dismissal before dawn whenever the theatre asks.
Threatening the clerk with dismissal on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever threaten the whole harvest with frost before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre threatens the whole harvest with frost on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother threatened the clerk with dismissal again, and the theatre remembered that half.
